The engine checks every decoded submitted value; the docs do not establish receiver ordering or selection for duplicate keys. Duplicate fixtures describe local validation behavior, not receiver policy.

The complete-capture extractor retains its pre-existing application/x-www-form-urlencoded body fallback for top-level parameter contracts. JSON body members do not satisfy the owner, but form carriers can supply seg_code/member. These extraction controls do not establish POST/form acceptance by the pixel receiver.
